verifier: blind Claude agent re-implementation (agent verification, not human)

open_drive_score_pre.note: drive = min fixed_drive among scrimmage plays; value = drive_ended_with_score of the first row of that drive among ALL non-deleted plays (incl. non-scrimmage rows). Reading 'first row' as first SCRIMMAGE row of the drive gives only 27/40.

drive_len_pre.note: drive_play_count from first row of each drive (drop_duplicates keep first), NaN drives dropped

def_drive_len_pre.note: drive_play_count from first row of each drive (drop_duplicates keep first), NaN drives dropped

ambiguities: first drive for open_drive_score: scrimmage-only min fixed_drive vs all-plays min fixed_drive; builder uses all-plays/first-row for score but scrimmage-only for open_drive_n/open_pass_rate
drive_ended_with_score of a drive: max vs first row vs literal 'drive ended with score' (value 1 also for Opp touchdown and Safety drives, i.e. not necessarily the team scoring)

drive_len: 'mean drive_play_count over distinct drives' is silent on which row supplies drive_play_count; drives whose first row is NaN (non-scrimmage lone rows) are silently excluded by builder; drive_play_count also counts non-scrimmage plays in the drive
takeaway_n_pre exists in sample but not in brief; its half-life (8, min 3) differs from takeaway_td_rate (20, 5)
nonoff_td_for includes all play types with posteam!=team (incl. kick/punt return TDs), and nonoff_td_against counts TDs where posteam==team scored by other team; interpreted literally, matches
Games without pbp or with NaN per-game values keep their position in the series so EWMA decay counts them; pbp starts 2010 so 2010-2011 early games have min_periods effects
gl_plays/own1 named 'plays' but restricted to scrimmage plays by brief; yardline_100>=95 includes plays at 95..99 (the 5-yard line and in), literal 'goal line' would be goal_to_go
go_4th_goal restricted to ydstogo<=3 AND goal_to_go==1 (brief), so name suggests all goal-to-go 4th downs
'FIRST ROW of that drive': first row among all plays (40/40) vs first scrimmage row (27/40); max over scrimmage rows 26/40
